# Part  1 - Data Processing

I'm going to use R's api functions to pull PUMS data down from the US Census website.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(janitor)
```
## Parsing Variable Values (i.e. labels)
```{r}
variable_json <- httr::GET("https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json")
#str(variable_json, max.level = 1)
parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(variable_json$content))

variable_descriptions <- as_tibble(parsed$variables)
variable_descriptions
saveRDS(variable_descriptions, file = "data/variable_descriptions.rds")
```


## Parsing API Data

```{r}
helper <- function(year = 2024, vars = "AGEP") {
  #vars = c("AGEP","GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP")
  
  #Test input parameters:
  #vars = "AGEP"
  #year <- 2024
  
  #Generate all the input parameters:
  address <- "https://api.census.gov/data/"
  variables <- paste("PWGTP,AGEP", vars, sep = ",")
  
  #Check validity of year
  if (length(year) != 1) {
    stop("Argument 'year' must be a single value, not a vector or list.")
  }
  #Options for users should be AGEP, GASP, GRPIP, JWAP, JWDP, JWMNP
  #if (match.arg(vars) != 1) {
    #stop("Dudeski, you chose variables that are not in our list. Please restrict to AGEP, GASP, GRPIP, JWAP, JWDP, JWMNP, and I'll toss in PWGTP for free. ;-)")
  #}

  #Call API and parse result
  final_api <- paste0(address,year,"/acs/acs1/pumspr?get=",variables, "&key=541a25ef175ec8d1abf1a4b9bb864ac88cf70e54")
  
  variable_json <- httr::GET(final_api)
  parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(variable_json$content))

  #Make API result into tibble, save it, and display it in the log
  api_result <- parsed |>
    janitor::row_to_names(row_number = 1) |>
    as_tibble()
  return(api_result)
}
yr2024 <- helper(vars = "GASP")
yr2024b<- helper()
yr2022 <- helper(year = 2022, vars = c("GASP","GRPIP")) 
yr2022b<- helper(year = 2022)

```
